spans.s: गृञ्ज, N. of a plant, = गृञ्जन (?).

गृञ्जन, अस्, m. garlic, or a small red variety of
it; a turnip; the tops of hemp chewed to produce
an inebriating effect, the Gāñja; (अम्), n. the bulb
of a kind of onion; poisoned flesh, the meat of an
animal destroyed by a poisoned arrow.
गृञ्जनक, अस्, m. a kind of garlic.

गृञ्जिम गृञ्जिम, अस्, m., N. of a son of
Śūra and brother of Vasu-deva.
